newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gold seen in $366.50-371.50 range next week-bank.
newsitem.headline: Gold seen in $366.50-371.50 range next week-bank.

text.p: Gold bullion was seen in a $366.50-371.50 range over the next week, Dresdner Bank said in a precious metals report on Friday.
The bank did not expect gold to break out of this range as markets prepared for a Christmas/New Year holiday lull.
But it saw chances of price rises in the medium term as the market was still oversold.
Gold could also benefit from investor moves out of other markets, where short term price highs had been reached, into the precious metals.
